blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The 14-day visa-free entry privilege for Chinese nationals has been extended for another year, allowing them to visit the country for tourism and business until 2028, according to the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA). In a statement on Monday, the DFA said the extension, which shall take effect from Jan. 16, 2027 to Jan. 15, 2028, was in line with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s directive “to boost international tourist arrivals and investments in the Philippines, while maintaining existing immigration and national security safeguards.” Under the arrangement, Chinese nationals may enter the Philippines without a visa for stays of […]...
